you play as a naked 5 year old toddler who uses acidic(?) tears to kill monsters whilst you go further down the basement

-alot of items and pickups to help you on your journey

theres only a few problems:

the engine itself will explode if you get certain item combinations due to the sheer amount of tears on the screen at once which will mostly happen if you loop your run either via the active item or rerun

the engine is limited in certain aspects when it comes to modding, requiring mods with more in-depth alterations to require 3rd party software named "REPENTOGON"

the co-op/multiplayer is the buggiest mess to exist which is the sole reason why rep+ has mixed reviews

the game engine runs at 60 fps, the visuals are at 30 fps which could be misleading to some

last issue but not least: "The Bloat" boss

important note: if you wanna have fun then buy afterbith+ bundle, alot of bug fixes, reworks and balancing changes are tied to dlc instead of game updates, it should also be noted that each dlc requires the previous one to work properly
